# Therapy with Shloka

> Culturally-informed online therapy for immigrants, first-generation adults and high-functioning adults across California. Led by Shloka Iyer, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT #154641), a South Asian therapist based in San Francisco.

## Pages

- [Home](https://therapywithshloka.com/): Overview of the practice, fees, insurance and how to start.
- [About](https://therapywithshloka.com/about): Shloka Iyer's background and practical details.
- [Who I Work With](https://therapywithshloka.com/who-i-work-with): Immigrants, first-generation adults and high-functioning adults.
- [My Approach](https://therapywithshloka.com/approach): Relational, exploratory therapy and how sessions work.
- [Resources](https://therapywithshloka.com/resources): Essays on identity, immigration and relationships, and short guides to the therapy process.
- [FAQ](https://therapywithshloka.com/faq): Fees ($200 per 50-minute session), insurance (Aetna, United Healthcare/Optum, Oxford), policies.
- [Contact](https://therapywithshloka.com/contact): Schedule a free 15-minute consultation.
